title: Denver Wedding for July 4th
author: madwire
excerpt: JAMMIN’ DJs did it again! The wedding was beautiful and the venue was almost as stunning as the bride! This wedding came complete with a 4th of July weekend fireworks display to celebrate the occasion. Congratulations to Ronnie and Danielle on their special day! We were all wrapped up by midnight. ~Bryan Evans~
